integrity_statement: Complete analytic proof; finite exact-arithmetic checker is corroborative only. Priority is best-knowledge, not certified. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only one-sided left multipliers on countable c0-sums of full compact-operator algebras; classical Banach-space s-numbers, not module-defined ones. No classification for arbitrary C*-algebras, non-atomic summands, or two-sided elementary maps.
title: Four classical s-number scales of module-rank-one multipliers on atomic compact-operator algebras
